handback.title: The reviewer's prompt spells out its duties and boxes
handback.summary: The reviewer's prompt names its four duties and the six boxes it fills for them.
handback.user_story: The reviewer's prompt names its four duties and the boxes it fills for each.

acceptance_criteria.text: The reviewer's prompt says every owner sentence maps to a criterion or is marked not a requirement, with a reason.
acceptance_criteria.words: Every sentence of the owner's maps to a criterion or is marked "not a requirement" with a reason.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text with no input; the test checks it at both review stages.

acceptance_criteria.text: The reviewer's prompt says later owner words win over older ones.
acceptance_criteria.words: Sources are append-only and later words win.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text with no input; the test checks it at both review stages.

acceptance_criteria.text: The reviewer's prompt says it confirms or retires a criterion code flags as stale.
acceptance_criteria.words: A criterion whose source is older than a later owner comment on the same point is flagged by code (#743); the reviewer confirms or retires it.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text with no input; the test checks it at both review stages.

acceptance_criteria.text: The reviewer's prompt says when two owner sources disagree unsettled, it asks the owner and never picks.
acceptance_criteria.words: When two owner sources disagree and no later word settles it, the reviewer asks the owner. It never picks.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text with no input; the test checks it at both review stages.

acceptance_criteria.text: The reviewer's prompt says any change serving no criterion blocks.
acceptance_criteria.words: anything that serves no criterion blocks
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text with no input; the test checks it at both review stages.

acceptance_criteria.text: The reviewer's prompt shows the six required boxes and their entry shapes.
acceptance_criteria.words: **Reviewer: required boxes.** One per duty, every box present, entries typed, each entry a blocker unless noted.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text with no input; the test checks every box at both review stages.
